observations: Figure 16 plots pipe cross-section bending moment versus global pipe curvature for various axial tension levels.
The paper reports good correlation between analytical and FP-RUC moment-curvature response at small curvature.
At larger curvature in the full-slip phase, FP-RUC and analytical results deviate.
The FP-RUC full-slip response is nonlinear, whereas the analytical total moment remains linear because it is governed by continuum-layer moment contributions.
evidence_boundary: No graphical curve digitization or FP-RUC recreation is claimed in Phase 1.
